---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m5p3t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Jobs, Slots, Workers, NoJob, Quorum

VARIABLES alloc, votes, requested, active
vars == <<alloc, votes, requested, active>>

Voters(j, s) == { v.worker : v \in { x \in votes : x.job = j /\ x.slot = s } }

TypeOK ==
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Jobs \cup {NoJob}]
    /\ votes \subseteq [job : Jobs, slot : Slots, worker : Workers]
    /\ requested \subseteq [job : Jobs, slot : Slots]
    /\ active \subseteq Workers

Init ==
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> NoJob]
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ requested = {}
    /\ active = Workers

Request(j, s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] = NoJob
    /\ \A r \in requested : r.slot # s
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s] \notin requested
    /\ requested' = requested \cup {[job |-> j, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, votes, active>>

GoSlow(w) ==
    /\ w \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, votes, requested>>

Resume(w) ==
    /\ w \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, votes, requested>>

Vote(w, j, s) ==
    /\ w \in active
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s] \in requested
    /\ alloc[s] = NoJob
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s, worker |-> w] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[job |-> j, slot |-> s, worker |-> w]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, requested, active>>

Commit(j, s) ==
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s] \in requested
    /\ alloc[s] = NoJob
    /\ Cardinality(Voters(j, s)) >= Quorum
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = j]
    /\ requested' = requested \ {[job |-> j, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] # NoJob
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NoJob]
    /\ votes' = { x \in votes : x.slot # s }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requested, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Request(j, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : GoSlow(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Resume(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Vote(w, j, s)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Commit(j, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllocBackedByQuorum ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        alloc[s] # NoJob => Cardinality(Voters(alloc[s], s)) >= Quorum
============================================================================
nl:
A print-shop spooler assigns physical printer slots to queued jobs, and every allocation must be ratified by a quorum of worker daemons rather than a single controller. A job first requests a specific free slot. Worker daemons that are currently responsive cast a vote endorsing a particular (job, slot) request; a daemon may be temporarily slow and stop responding for a while, but it has not failed and can become responsive again later. A request is only committed -- turning into a real allocation -- once at least a quorum of distinct daemons have voted for that exact (job, slot) pair while the slot is still free. When a slot is released, its allocation is cleared and its accumulated votes are discarded so it can be re-contested. Because commitment always demands a fresh quorum tied to the winning job, the same slot can never be handed to a job that a quorum never endorsed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every slot that is currently allocated to a job is backed by at least a quorum of distinct daemon votes endorsing that job for that slot.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m9p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxSeats, MaxVer

VARIABLES log, version, prepared, pool
vars == <<log, version, prepared, pool>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in Seq([inst : Instances, base : Nat])
    /\ version \in Nat
    /\ prepared \subseteq [inst : Instances, base : Nat]
    /\ pool \in 0..MaxSeats

Init ==
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ version = 0
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ pool = MaxSeats

Prepare(i) ==
    /\ \A p \in prepared : p.inst # i
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {[inst |-> i, base |-> version]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, pool>>

Refresh(i) ==
    /\ \E p \in prepared :
        /\ p.inst = i
        /\ p.base # version
        /\ prepared' = (prepared \ {p}) \cup {[inst |-> i, base |-> version]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, pool>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ \E p \in prepared :
        /\ p.inst = i
        /\ p.base = version
        /\ version < MaxVer
        /\ pool > 0
        /\ log' = Append(log, [inst |-> i, base |-> version])
        /\ version' = version + 1
        /\ pool' = pool - 1
        /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}

Discard(i) ==
    /\ \E p \in prepared : p.inst = i /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, pool>>

ReleaseSeat ==
    /\ pool < MaxSeats
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, prepared>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Prepare(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Refresh(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Discard(i)
    \/ ReleaseSeat

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ version = Len(log)
    /\ \A k \in 1..Len(log) : log[k].base = k - 1
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Instances = {rA, rB}
    MaxSeats = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A university course-registration service is served by two independent registrar instances that share a single seat pool for a course. The authoritative roster is kept as an append-only log, and the shared record carries a version number equal to the log length. To enroll a student, an instance first prepares by reading the current version. It may commit that preparation only if the version it read still matches the current version and a seat is available; committing appends one entry recording the base version it observed and advances the version by one, consuming a seat. If another instance committed first, the stale preparation must be refreshed against the new version before it can proceed, so no update is silently overwritten. Released seats return to the shared pool for later enrollments. Because every committed entry is stamped with the version it superseded, the log forms an unbroken chain with no lost updates.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each committed roster entry records a base version exactly one less than its position in the log, so no concurrent enrollment overwrites another.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m8p5t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Instances, Symbols, NoOne

VARIABLES coarse, fine, open, plog
vars == <<coarse, fine, open, plog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Instances \cup {NoOne}
    /\ fine \in [Symbols -> Instances \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ open \subseteq Symbols
    /\ plog \in Seq([inst : Instances, sym : Symbols])

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NoOne
    /\ fine = [s \in Symbols |-> NoOne]
    /\ open = {}
    /\ plog = <<>>

AcquireCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = NoOne
    /\ coarse' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, open, plog>>

AcquireFine(i, s) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[s] = NoOne
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, open, plog>>

OpenBook(i, s) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ s \notin open
    /\ open' = open \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, plog>>

Print(i, s) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[s] = i
    /\ s \in open
    /\ \A k \in DOMAIN plog : plog[k].sym # s
    /\ plog' = Append(plog, [inst |-> i, sym |-> s])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, open>>

ReleaseFine(i, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = i
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, open, plog>>

ReleaseCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ \A s \in Symbols : fine[s] # i
    /\ coarse' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, open, plog>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : AcquireCoarse(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : AcquireFine(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : OpenBook(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : Print(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : ReleaseFine(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : ReleaseCoarse(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoublePrint ==
    \A a, b \in DOMAIN plog : (a # b) => plog[a].sym # plog[b].sym
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Instances = {mA, mB}
    Symbols = {x, y}
    NoOne = NoOne
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoublePrint
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction in which two independent matching-engine instances draw from a single shared pool of resting orders. To cross a symbol and print its official opening price -- an irreversible act -- an engine must first take the coarse market-wide lock, then the fine per-symbol lock, respecting a strict hierarchy: the fine lock may be held only by the engine currently holding the coarse lock. A symbol's book must be opened before it can be crossed. Printing the opening price appends an entry to the official cross log recording which engine crossed which symbol, and a symbol that already appears in the cross log may never be crossed again. Engines release the fine lock and then the coarse lock when done, letting the other engine proceed. Because the hierarchy funnels every cross through a single coarse-lock holder and the guard rejects already-crossed symbols, each symbol's opening print occurs at most once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No symbol appears more than once in the official cross log, so each opening price is printed at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m5p4t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, Reqs, Reviewers, Quorum, Cap

VARIABLES pending, votes, active, done
vars == <<pending, votes, active, done>>

Voters(r) == { x.rev : x \in { y \in votes : y.req = r } }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pending \subseteq [id : Reqs, inst : Instances]
    /\ votes \subseteq [req : Reqs, rev : Reviewers]
    /\ active \subseteq Reqs
    /\ done \subseteq Reqs

Init ==
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ active = {}
    /\ done = {}

Submit(i, r) ==
    /\ r \notin active
    /\ r \notin done
    /\ \A p \in pending : p.id # r
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[id |-> r, inst |-> i]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, done>>

Vote(v, r) ==
    /\ \E p \in pending : p.id = r
    /\ [req |-> r, rev |-> v] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[req |-> r, rev |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, active, done>>

Begin(r) ==
    /\ \E p \in pending : p.id = r
    /\ Cardinality(Voters(r)) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(active) < Cap
    /\ active' = active \cup {r}
    /\ pending' = { p \in pending : p.id # r }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, done>>

Complete(r) ==
    /\ r \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {r}
    /\ done' = done \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes>>

Recall(r) ==
    /\ r \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {r}
    /\ votes' = { x \in votes : x.req # r }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Reqs : Submit(i, r)
    \/ \E v \in Reviewers, r \in Reqs : Vote(v, r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Begin(r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Complete(r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Recall(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK ==
    /\ Cardinality(active) <= Cap
    /\ \A r \in active : Cardinality(Voters(r)) >= Quorum
============================================================================
nl:
A pharmacy runs two independent dispensing instances that draw from a single shared set of dispensing bays. Filling a prescription is gated by quorum: pharmacist reviewers must vote to endorse a submitted request before it can begin. An instance submits a prescription request; reviewers who are on duty cast endorsing votes for that request. A request may begin dispensing only once a quorum of distinct reviewers has endorsed it and a free bay exists in the shared pool. While dispensing, the prescription occupies one bay; when dispensing completes, the bay is freed for reuse. A completed prescription can later be recalled and re-submitted, discarding its old votes. The shared bay pool has a fixed capacity, and because a request occupies a bay only after clearing quorum, the number of prescriptions dispensing at once can never exceed that capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of prescriptions dispensing simultaneously never exceeds the bay capacity, and every dispensing prescription holds a quorum of reviewer endorsements.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, Cap

Nodes == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(n) == (n + 1) % N

VARIABLES token, opened, want, adminOn
vars == <<token, opened, want, adminOn>>

    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ opened \subseteq Nodes
    /\ want \subseteq Nodes
    /\ adminOn \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ opened = {}
    /\ want = {}
    /\ adminOn = FALSE

Request(n) ==

    /\ n \notin opened
    /\ want' = want \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, opened, adminOn>>

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<opened, want, adminOn>>

Open(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ n \in want
    /\ n \notin opened
    /\ Cardinality(opened) < Cap
    /\ opened' = opened \cup {n}
    /\ want' = want \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminOn>>

Close(n) ==
    /\ n \in opened
    /\ opened' = opened \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, want, adminOn>>

AdminToggle ==
    /\ adminOn' = ~adminOn
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, opened, want>>

AdminOpen(n) ==
    /\ adminOn
    /\ n \notin opened
    /\ Cardinality(opened) < Cap
    /\ opened' = opened \cup {n}
    /\ want' = want \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminOn>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Request(n)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Open(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Close(n)
    \/ AdminToggle
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : AdminOpen(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BoundedOpen == Cardinality(opened) <= Cap

    N = 3
    Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedOpen
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network arranges its locks in a logical ring around which a single access token circulates; only the node currently holding the token may open its own door in normal operation. Nodes register a request when they want to open. The token is passed hand to hand to the next node in the ring, giving each lock its turn at exclusive access. For safety the home enforces a bounded capacity: no more than a fixed number of doors may stand open at the same time, so the token holder can open its door only if that capacity is not already reached, and it clears its request when it does. A privileged administrator override can be switched on, allowing the admin to open any door directly without waiting for the token. Even under admin override the open-door capacity limit is respected, so the number of simultaneously open doors never exceeds the safety bound.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of doors open at the same time never exceeds the network's fixed capacity bound.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m1p4t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, Trains, Zone, Cap

Blocks == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(b) == (b + 1) % N

VARIABLES pos, token, reqs, msgs
vars == <<pos, token, reqs, msgs>>

Occupied(b) == \E t \in Trains : pos[t] = b
InZone == { t \in Trains : pos[t] \in Zone }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pos \in [Trains -> Blocks]
    /\ token \in Blocks
    /\ reqs \subseteq Trains
    /\ msgs \subseteq [train : Trains, dest : Blocks]

Init ==
    /\ pos = [t \in Trains |-> 0]
    /\ token = 0
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ msgs = {}

Request(t) ==
    /\ t \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, token, msgs>>

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, reqs, msgs>>

Grant(t) ==
    /\ t \in reqs
    /\ token = pos[t]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[train |-> t, dest |-> Succ(pos[t])]}
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, token>>

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ ~Occupied(m.dest)
    /\ (m.dest \in Zone => Cardinality(InZone) < Cap)
    /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![m.train] = m.dest]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Request(t)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Grant(t)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Deliver(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK == Cardinality(InZone) <= Cap
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    N = 4
    Trains = {t1, t2}
    Zone = {1, 2}
    Cap = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapOK
nl:
A subway line is divided into track blocks arranged in a ring, with a single movement-authority token circulating from block to block. Trains sitting on the line register a request to advance. Authority is granted only when the token currently rests on the block a requesting train occupies; granting emits a movement message telling that train to step to the next block and clears its request. These movement messages accumulate in an unordered buffer and may be delivered in any order, modeling a network where messages can be reordered. A movement message is applied only when its destination block is unoccupied, and a strict capacity limits how many trains may sit inside the central station zone at once, so a train enters the zone only if that limit is not already reached. Because entry into the zone is always gated by the capacity check regardless of message ordering, the zone never holds more trains than its bound allows.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of trains occupying the central station zone at any moment never exceeds the zone's capacity limit.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m8p3t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Fridges, Shelves, Handlers, Orders, NoOne, NoOrder

Slots == [fridge : Fridges, shelf : Shelves]

VARIABLES coarse, fine, alloc, slow
vars == <<coarse, fine, alloc, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Fridges -> Handlers \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ fine \in [Slots -> Handlers \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Orders \cup {NoOrder}]
    /\ slow \subseteq Handlers

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [f \in Fridges |-> NoOne]
    /\ fine = [s \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> NoOrder]
    /\ slow = {}

GoSlow(h) == /\ h \notin slow /\ slow' = slow \cup {h} /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, alloc>>
Resume(h) == /\ h \in slow /\ slow' = slow \ {h} /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, alloc>>

AcquireCoarse(h, f) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ coarse[f] = NoOne
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![f] = h]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, alloc, slow>>

AcquireFine(h, s) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ coarse[s.fridge] = h
    /\ fine[s] = NoOne
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = h]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, alloc, slow>>

Claim(h, s, o) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ fine[s] = h
    /\ alloc[s] = NoOrder
    /\ \A t \in Slots : alloc[t] # o
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = o]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, slow>>

Deallocate(h, s) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ fine[s] = h
    /\ alloc[s] # NoOrder
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NoOrder]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, slow>>

ReleaseFine(h, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = h
    /\ alloc[s] = NoOrder
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, alloc, slow>>

ReleaseCoarse(h, f) ==
    /\ coarse[f] = h
    /\ \A s \in Slots : (s.fridge = f) => fine[s] # h
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![f] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, alloc, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E h \in Handlers : GoSlow(h)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers : Resume(h)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, f \in Fridges : AcquireCoarse(h, f)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots : AcquireFine(h, s)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots, o \in Orders : Claim(h, s, o)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots : Deallocate(h, s)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots : ReleaseFine(h, s)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, f \in Fridges : ReleaseCoarse(h, f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllocProtected ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        alloc[s] # NoOrder =>
            /\ fine[s] # NoOne
            /\ coarse[s.fridge] = fine[s]
============================================================================
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker stores units in refrigerators, each holding several shelf slots. To assign a slot to an order, a handler must obey a strict lock hierarchy: first take the coarse lock on the whole refrigerator, then the fine lock on the specific shelf slot, and the fine lock may be held only by the handler that holds the enclosing refrigerator's coarse lock. Only a handler holding a slot's fine lock may claim that empty slot for an order, and it keeps both locks until it has deallocated the slot again, releasing the fine lock before the coarse lock. Handlers may become temporarily slow and stop taking steps for a while, but they have not failed and resume later. Because an allocated slot is always shielded by matching coarse and fine locks held by one handler, no second handler can slip in and allocate the same slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every slot that currently holds an allocation is protected by its fine lock and the matching refrigerator coarse lock held by the same handler.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m0p6t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Pharmacists, MaxCap

VARIABLES log, authorized, everAuth, readv, cap
vars == <<log, authorized, everAuth, readv, cap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in Seq([who : Pharmacists, base : 0..MaxCap])
    /\ authorized \subseteq Pharmacists
    /\ everAuth \subseteq Pharmacists
    /\ readv \in [Pharmacists -> 0..MaxCap]
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ authorized = {}
    /\ everAuth = {}
    /\ readv = [p \in Pharmacists |-> 0]
    /\ cap = 1

Grant(p) ==
    /\ p \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {p}
    /\ everAuth' = everAuth \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, readv, cap>>

Revoke(p) ==
    /\ p \in authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, everAuth, readv, cap>>

Read(p) ==
    /\ readv[p] # Len(log)
    /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![p] = Len(log)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, authorized, everAuth, cap>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ p \in authorized
    /\ readv[p] = Len(log)
    /\ Len(log) < cap
    /\ log' = Append(log, [who |-> p, base |-> readv[p]])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, everAuth, readv, cap>>

SetCap(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c # cap
    /\ c >= Len(log)
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, authorized, everAuth, readv>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Grant(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Revoke(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Commit(p)
    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : SetCap(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleOrUnauth ==
    /\ Len(log) <= cap
    /\ \A k \in 1..Len(log) :
        /\ log[k].base = k - 1
        /\ log[k].who \in everAuth
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {ph1, ph2}
    MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleOrUnauth
nl:
A pharmacy dispenser uses optimistic locking to serialize commits to a shared dispense log whose length acts as the current version. Each pharmacist first reads the current version into a private register, then attempts to commit a dispense. A commit succeeds only if the pharmacist is currently authorized and the version it read still equals the live version; the commit appends a log entry stamped with the observed base version. If another commit landed first, the pharmacist's read is stale and must be refreshed to the new version before retrying, so a stale participant cannot commit. Authorization can be granted and later revoked at runtime, and only ever-authorized pharmacists may appear in the log. The dispensing capacity is also adjusted at runtime, and the log may never grow beyond the current capacity. Together these guards ensure no unauthorized or stale participant ever writes a dispense.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every log entry is stamped with a base version one less than its position and was written by a pharmacist that was authorized at some point, and the log never exceeds the current capacity.

    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ votes \subseteq [bank : Banks, epoch : 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Banks
    /\ authorized \subseteq Banks
    /\ clog \in Seq([voters : SUBSET Banks])

ValidVoters ==
    { v.bank : v \in { x \in votes :

    /\ ttl[z] > 0

nl:
A pharmacy tracks a fixed number of drug units that are conserved: every unit is always in exactly one of three buckets -- on-hand stock, dispensed, or quarantined -- and none are ever created or destroyed. The on-hand stock count doubles as a compare-and-swap register. To dispense a unit a pharmacist first reads the current stock into a private register, then commits only if the stock still equals the value it read and is positive; a successful commit atomically moves one unit from stock to dispensed. If another operation changed the stock in the meantime, the pharmacist's read is stale and it must re-read before retrying. A privileged administrator override, when switched on, may move units directly between stock and quarantine without going through the compare-and-swap protocol, for recalls and restocking. Because every operation moves a unit from one bucket to another and never invents or discards one, the total number of units across the three buckets stays constant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of units on-hand plus dispensed plus quarantined always equals the fixed total, so no unit is ever created or destroyed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m6p4t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks, Zone, Cap, TTL, NoTrain

VARIABLES lease, ttl, reqs, slow
vars == <<lease, ttl, reqs, slow>>

LiveZone == { b \in Zone : lease[b] # NoTrain }

TypeOK ==
    /\ lease \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {NoTrain}]
    /\ ttl \in [Blocks -> 0..TTL]
    /\ reqs \subseteq [train : Trains, block : Blocks]
    /\ slow \subseteq Trains

Init ==
    /\ lease = [b \in Blocks |-> NoTrain]
    /\ ttl = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ slow = {}

Request(t, b) ==
    /\ [train |-> t, block |-> b] \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {[train |-> t, block |-> b]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, slow>>

AcquireLease(t, b) ==
    /\ t \notin slow
    /\ [train |-> t, block |-> b] \in reqs
    /\ lease[b] = NoTrain
    /\ (b \in Zone => Cardinality(LiveZone) < Cap)
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = TTL]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {[train |-> t, block |-> b]}
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

Renew(t, b) ==
    /\ t \notin slow
    /\ lease[b] = t
    /\ ttl[b] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, reqs, slow>>

Tick ==
    /\ \E b \in Blocks : ttl[b] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF ttl[b] > 0 THEN ttl[b] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ lease' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF ttl[b] = 1 THEN NoTrain ELSE lease[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, slow>>

Release(t, b) ==
    /\ lease[b] = t
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = NoTrain]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, slow>>

GoSlow(t) == /\ t \notin slow /\ slow' = slow \cup {t} /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, reqs>>
Resume(t) == /\ t \in slow /\ slow' = slow \ {t} /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Request(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : AcquireLease(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Renew(t, b)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Release(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : GoSlow(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Resume(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LeaseCapacity == Cardinality(LiveZone) <= Cap
============================================================================
nl:
A subway signalling system grants movement authority over track blocks using time-bounded leases. A train registers a request for authority over a block, and an acquire grants the requesting train a lease on that block, setting the lease timer to its full duration. The signalling zone enforces a bounded capacity: at most a fixed number of blocks in the zone may hold live leases at once, so an acquire for a zone block is refused when that many zone leases are already live. A clock tick counts down every lease timer and releases any lease whose timer reaches zero, and a train may also renew a live lease it holds or release it explicitly. A train's controller may become temporarily slow, halting its acquire and renew steps for a while without failing, and it resumes later. Because granting a zone lease is always gated by the live-lease capacity check, the number of zone blocks under live lease never exceeds the capacity bound.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of zone blocks holding a live lease at any moment never exceeds the zone's capacity bound.
